title: Shared scope descriptor
description: The private .ai-badger/shared-scope.json of one repository in a shared collection: either the collection parent's member list, or a child's authored settings (its original local stacks and its overrides of the parent's defaults). Closed shapes: an unknown field is a mistake, not an extension.

members.description: The explicitly selected member repositories, relative to the collection root.

source.description: The parent scope this child reads, relative to the child root. Absent until the child is enrolled.

localStacks.description: The child's own stacks, kept apart from the parent's effective union.

parentId.description: The project id of the collection this child is enrolled in. It is what tells one collection's member from another's.

overrides.description: The child's authored settings, merged over the parent's defaults.
